visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with short dark hair and round glasses is seated in a brightly lit office, wearing a light beige professional blouse. She is holding a purple smartphone and looking directly into the camera while gesturing with her right hand. The background consists of a dark table lamp, framed certificates on the wall, and a professional clinic setting. (2) The scene transitions to a 2D animation showing brown pigment particles (melanin) being transported through finger-like cellular structures against a beige background, illustrating skin cell processes. (3) The camera returns to the female character in the same office environment. She points to her cheek and uses varied hand gestures to emphasize her points. A white laboratory coat is visible hanging on the chair behind her. (4) The video concludes with a static graphic screen featuring the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo, contact handles for LINE, a phone number, and two physical office addresses in New Taipei and Taipei City.
